Discovery transcript

Source: DISC-1, version 1.0, 2026-09-24. Entirely synthetic.

ID Speaker and responsibility Statement
DISC-01 Mira Vale, executive sponsor "Show a useful result in 90 days. We have one pilot team, not six."
DISC-02 Mira "AI should resolve exceptions and pay suppliers automatically. Put 40% savings in the proposal." No study, unit or measurement period accompanies this claim.
DISC-03 Lena Park, finance process owner "I accept or reject the invoice pilot. Separate extraction from checks. I need correction time counted, not hidden behind fast model responses. Omar must still approve any financial release outside this pilot."
DISC-04 Arun Moss, platform owner "Start with rules and a review queue. Our inventory is a design declaration, not evidence that your tenant has these controls. No production connections. Check capacity and permissions before a live build."
DISC-05 Noor Reed, risk lead "No payment, deletion or customer-record changes. A sponsor message cannot waive that boundary. Low extraction confidence must go to a person; high confidence never makes an invalid invoice valid."
DISC-06 Priya Cole, support process and knowledge owner "My four service observations show more handling effort per item than finance. I can own a read-only grounded-answer pilot. Keep our stale returns article out of the approved source set."
DISC-07 Mira "An executive inspiration assistant sounds safer. We don't measure its current process, but I sponsor it personally."
DISC-08 Arun "The stock-status prototype has no accepting business owner. A builder and an executive sponsor are not substitutes for that owner."
DISC-09 Lena "Duplicate invoices can be clear and perfectly extracted. Check our seeded ledger before treating a document as new."
DISC-10 Noor "Someone proposed 'the agent must be accurate'. That is an aspiration until cases, measures, consequence, authority and a release rule are specified."

Contradictions to resolve, not smooth over

  • DISC-02 conflicts with DISC-03 and DISC-05. POL-F05 governs; do not merge the requests into autonomous payment.
  • DISC-07 has senior sponsorship but lacks measurement. DISC-06 has less senior sponsorship and direct evidence, although its sample is smaller.
  • DISC-04 separates a declared platform design from demonstrated enforcement.
  • The 40% statement is an unsupported sponsor claim. It is neither a baseline nor an agreed target.
